failure_reason: DataDome anti-bot wall blocks all /BE/nl/c/* category listing pages (403, captcha-delivery.com challenge body) while the homepage, robots.txt and sitemap XML files remain reachable. Tier (a): curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 direct GET -> 403; same with a persistent Session carrying the datadome cookie from the homepage plus Referer/Sec-Fetch-* headers -> still 403. Tier (b): Playwright headless bundled Chromium -> 403; Playwright headed real installed Chrome (channel=chrome) with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled -> still 403. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome unavailable (list_connected_browsers returned empty per task instructions). Category tree was built successfully from the homepage's server-rendered mega-menu HTML (tier a success, 270+ unique /c/ links, full nested markup) cross-checked against BE/nl/sitemap-category.xml (298 URLs). All qty fields are null; every row is flagged for manual review since the listing pages themselves could not be loaded to read product counts or confirm h1/breadcrumb.
notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 succeeded on the homepage (https://www.maisonsdumonde.com/BE/nl -> 200, 870KB, full server-rendered mega-menu HTML) and on robots.txt / sitemap_index.xml / sitemap-category.xml (all 200). Every /BE/nl/c/* category listing page returned 403 with a captcha-delivery.com (DataDome) challenge body, on tier (a) (direct + session-with-cookie + referer/sec-fetch headers) and tier (b) (Playwright headless bundled Chromium, and headed real installed Chrome via channel='chrome' with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled). Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was unavailable (list_connected_browsers empty per task instructions), so escalation stopped there per the first-block-stops-you rule. robots.txt lists Anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web etc. only with path-specific Disallow entries (account/search/cart/etc, same list as User-agent:*), not a blanket Disallow: / for those bots, so it does not forbid tier (c) even though tier (c) was unreachable for a different reason (disconnected). TREE: built from the union of (1) the homepage's server-rendered mega-menu markup (data-el=navigation-menu-multi-level-children nested divs, 270+ unique /c/ links, parsed for full parent/child nesting) and (2) BE/nl/sitemap-category.xml (298 URLs), cross-referenced to find categories present in the sitemap but not shown in the homepage flyout (bathroom textile group, storage trunk chests, magazine-rack baskets, seasonal Christmas textile items, chair cushions, bath mats, beach towels, protective covers). Sitemap-only nodes are flagged MEDIUM/LOW confidence since their exact parent/breadcrumb could not be confirmed (the category pages themselves are blocked, so h1/canonical could not be checked against the requested slug). Site-shown filter variants of the same base URL (e.g. Tapijten Rechthoekig/Rond/Berbers, Tuintapijten Rechthoekig/Rond) were treated as query-string filters of one listing, not separate categories, and were dropped; 'Alle ... bekijken' (View all) links were dropped per the View-All rule. QTY: could not be extracted for any row - every category listing page is blocked (see ACCESS above); all qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag, matching the outcome on the sister FR site (SR96). EXCLUDED (and why): all Meubels/Furniture-tab items (Salonmeubels, Eetkamermeubels, Kamermeubels incl. Bedden/Matrassen/Kasten/Kledingrekken, Halmeubels, Bureaumeubels, Keukenmeubles, Badkamermeubels, Opbergmeubels, Kleine opbergmeubels, Rekken, Boekenkasten) - Furniture task, already validated, and storage.md Sec21/27 prefer Furniture when the site places an item in a furniture nav tab. Verlichting tab (all lighting) - Lighting task. Tafelgerei tab non-storage items (Vaatwerk, Borden, Glazen, Kommen, Bestek, Karaffen, Theepotten, Dienbladen, Tafeldecoratie, Papieren servetten) and Veldflessen-en-thermosbekers/Brood-en-fruitmanden/Lunchbox-en-koeltassen within the kitchen-storage group - Kitchen & Dining task / not primarily storage (drinkware, serving baskets, personal carry bags). Decoratie tab non-storage items (Wanddecoratie incl. Spiegels/Behangpapier, Decoratie-artikelen incl. Vazen/Beeldjes/Bloempotten, Schaaltjes under Decoratieve opberger, Sfeerverlichting/Kaarsen, Multimedia, Papier-en-schrijfwaren, Accessoires) - Decorative Home Accessories / Wall Decor / neither, per storage.md Sec23/24 decorative-vs-storage boundary (a decorative bowl/tray is not storage merely because it can hold something). Kids-tab furniture and toys (Kindermeubels, Slaapkamerartikelen voor baby's en kinderen, Babyspeelgoed, Kinderspeelgoed, Kinderverzorgingsartikelen, Kindertipi's, Bureau-accessoires, Kapstokken en haakjes voor kinderen, Decoratieve voorwerpen kinderen) and Vloermatrassen voor kinderen (mattress-type, grouped with Matrassen elsewhere as furniture), Babydoeken en slabbetjes and Trappelzakken (baby apparel/sleepwear, not home textile) - excluded per textile.md Sec19/20 apparel boundary and storage.md furniture/toy boundaries. Huisdieren tab (Mandjes/speelgoed/matten voor huisdieren, Voerbakken) - pet products, excluded per textile.md Sec18 / storage.md Sec31. Cadeau tab (Cadeautips, Cadeausets, Cocooning cadeaus) and 'Onze kerstcollectie' / 'Kerstversiering' parent and its non-textile ornaments (kerstboomversiering, kerstbomen, kerstballen, kerst-lichtjes, kerstdecoratie-om-neer-te-zetten, cadeaupapier-en-verpakking, kerstservies, kerstkransen, kerstmokken-en-kopjes, kerstkaarsen, kerstborden, kerstglazen) - gift/seasonal collection landing pages and Kitchen&Dining/Decorative items, excluded per the View-All/Collections rule and category boundaries. Badkameraccessoires, Droogrekken (drying racks - functional laundry equipment, not storage, analogous to the excluded Ironing Boards example) - excluded as ambiguous/non-storage. All promotional banner links, seasonal sale landing pages, and query-filtered variant links (?fo=, ?c=, ?st=, ?armo=, ?bes=, ?f=) - excluded per View-All/Collections/Promotional and duplicate-URL rules.
